newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen track JGBs higher in technical trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen track JGBs higher in technical trade.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen and Japanese government bond (JGB) futures headed higher in technically driven trade on Thursday as players remained undeterred by news Japan's ruling party planned to speed up financial deregulation.
"There was not a huge amount of fundamental news. So the technicals kicked in," said a trader with a European house.

He said stop-loss orders were triggered above 125.30 in June JGBs, causing some players to cover their short positions. The contract settled at 125.35 against its previous 124.89 after establishing a new high of 125.43.
Dealers said rollover activity had also picked up ahead of the March JGB contract's expiry.
"Those who were short in the Marches were clearing their positions and looking to go long into June because things are looking more bullish," said the trader.
Euroyen futures tracked the JGB rise but remained confined to narrow ranges. December was quoted at 99.21 at 1110 GMT against its IMM close at 99.18.
Eurodollar futures were practically static after a firm opening on the back of market-friendly comments by U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan.

The Fed chief's remark that the central bank was not out to deflate the stock market by boosting interest rates alleviated some of the concerns triggered by his mention last week of a pre-emptive rate hike as a way of checking inflation.

"The Eurodollars are looking slightly better, relecting Greenspan's more dovish comments. But at the end of the day, the Fed will move pre-emptively of any of the inflation indicators uptick," said the trader.
He said the market would have to head lower before any real buying emerged, but players were likely to sit on their hands ahead of the U.S. non-farm payrolls report on Friday.
"I would buy the September at 93.95/96 but cautiously, with a one-two tick stop behind me," he said.
September ended at 94.005 after opening at 94.000 against its IMM close at 93.975.
